name: Voxel-grid Super-Resolution
definition: Predicting an upsampled voxel grid of higher resolution from a lower resolution input grid using a U-Net style encoder-decoder network, serving as a fast alternative to querying an implicit MLP for higher resolution.
summary: Voxel-grid Super-Resolution is a fast grid upsampling technique that predicts higher-resolution voxel grids from lower-resolution inputs using a U-Net, serving as a faster alternative to querying implicit MLPs.
